connect.title: Connections
connect.intro: Just a username: public profiles are read, no password or API key. Syncing only adds: what is missing here is added, what you watched there is ticked here, nothing is removed. To send what is missing the other way, export a file and import it on the service.
connect.web: In a browser these sites refuse to be read: use the phone app.
connect.exportLetterboxd: CSV of the films you watched that Letterboxd doesn’t have. Import it at letterboxd.com/import.
connect.exportAnime: MyAnimeList XML of your anime missing there. Import it at myanimelist.net/import.php or in AniList settings › Import.
connect.autoHint: Connected accounts are read again when you open the app, twice a day at most.
connect.filesHint: Letterboxd (diary.csv, watched.csv, ratings.csv, watchlist.csv from Settings › Data › Export), Serializd (diary export, CSV or JSON) and IMDb (ratings or watchlist CSV). Several at once is fine.
connect.failed: Couldn’t read it. Check the username and that the profile is public.
connect.unmatchedHint: These couldn’t be matched to TVmaze or a film source. They are retried in a few days.
connect.serializdHint: Your diary: shows, seasons and episodes (public profile)
connect.exportSerializd: Serializd has no import page yet, so it can only be read from. Shows from TVmaze are matched by title, or exactly with a TMDB key.
